pa.admin_policy_desc: Applies to everyone holding an administrative role, whatever other policies they have.
pa.delete_failed: The policy could not be deleted.
pa.delete_text: Its roles go back to the system-wide session settings.
pa.denied.device: Your access policy allows only trusted devices. Sign in again and confirm with your second factor to trust this device.
pa.denied.ip: Your access policy does not allow sign-in from this network.
pa.denied.time: Your access policy does not allow sign-in at this time.
pa.empty_text: Without a policy, the system-wide session settings apply to everyone.
pa.key_hint: Lowercase letters, digits and underscores; used in packages.
pa.load_failed: Access policies could not be loaded.
pa.max_sessions_hint: Signing in beyond this ends the oldest sessions. Empty means no limit.
pa.my_devices_hint: Devices where you confirmed your second factor. Forget one to make it ask again.
pa.name: Name
pa.networks_hint: One address or range per line, such as 10.0.0.0/8. Leave empty to allow any network.
pa.require_2fa_desc: Holders must set up two-factor sign-in before they can work.
pa.require_device_desc: A device becomes trusted when the second factor is confirmed on it, for 90 days. Implies a second factor.
pa.roles_hint: A role has at most one policy; choosing it here moves it from any other.
pa.save_failed: The change could not be saved.
pa.subtitle: Where, when and how the holders of some roles may work. Someone governed by several policies gets the strictest of them.
pa.windows_hint: Work is allowed within any of these windows. A window that ends before it starts runs past midnight. Leave none to allow any time.
